instructions_to_main_agent: Create a static React frontend with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling to give a premium feel.
Use General Sans for headings and Nunito for body copy.
Build a sticky premium header that starts transparent and turns to crystal glass (solid white with blur) on scroll.
Implement an Apple-style cinematic hero section with scroll reveals and large imagery with a max overlay of bg-black/30 or bg-white/20.
Use a Bento grid layout (Tetris mode) for 'Why Choose Us' and 'Facilities'.
Include a Masonry Gallery with lightbox functionality.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Follow generous spacing (py-24 or py-32 for major sections).
Include a floating WhatsApp inquiry shortcut and 'Apply Now' CTA.
Build a premium dark footer using Deep Royal Blue bg-[#0F3D91].
